tools.name: trakt_search
tools.title: Find a movie or show
tools.description: Search Trakt movies and shows by title. Genre and year filters apply only to the returned page, while pagination metadata describes the unfiltered search, so a filtered page can be empty while later pages still match.

years.description: A year or inclusive YYYY-YYYY range.

tools.name: trakt_get_title
tools.title: Read a title's details
tools.description: Read the full details of one movie, show, or episode by its Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID. An episode also needs its season and episode numbers.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

tools.name: trakt_get_people
tools.title: Read a title's cast and crew
tools.description: Read the cast and crew of one movie, show, or episode. An episode also needs its season and episode numbers.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

tools.name: trakt_get_related
tools.title: Read related titles
tools.description: Read one page of movies or shows Trakt lists as related to a title.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

tools.name: trakt_get_seasons
tools.title: Read a show's seasons and episodes
tools.description: Read every season of a show with its episodes, including each episode's Trakt ID, season number, and episode number.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

tools.name: trakt_lookup_id
tools.title: Find a title by an external ID
tools.description: Find a movie, show, season, episode, or person from a Trakt, IMDb, TMDB, or TVDB ID.

tools.name: trakt_get_recommendations
tools.title: Get personalized recommendations
tools.description: Get Trakt's personalized movie/show recommendations based on its viewing/preferences signals, filtered by genre and year. Select movie or show; limit 1-100.

years.description: A year or inclusive YYYY-YYYY range.

tools.name: trakt_get_trending
tools.title: Read trending titles
tools.description: Read one page of the movies, shows, or both that are being watched most right now on Trakt, with optional genre, year, and library filters.

years.description: A year or inclusive YYYY-YYYY range.

tools.name: trakt_get_popular
tools.title: Read popular titles
tools.description: Read one page of the movies, shows, or both that are most popular overall on Trakt, with optional genre, year, and library filters.

years.description: A year or inclusive YYYY-YYYY range.

tools.name: trakt_get_anticipated
tools.title: Read anticipated titles
tools.description: Read one page of the movies, shows, or both that are most anticipated and not yet released on Trakt, with optional genre, year, and library filters.

years.description: A year or inclusive YYYY-YYYY range.

tools.name: trakt_hide_recommendation
tools.title: Hide a recommendation
tools.description: Hide one movie or show from the connected account's future recommendations. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_get_calendar
tools.title: Read upcoming Trakt releases
tools.description: Get one bounded UTC date window of releases from the personal (my) or public (all) calendar. kind selects shows, new shows, season premieres, finales, movies, streaming releases, or DVD releases. Dates and availability can change; a release is not proof of streaming access.

tools.name: trakt_get_watched_history
tools.title: Read watched movies and history
tools.description: Read one page (default 100) of the connected account's viewing. mode=all returns watched-title summaries with play counts, not play events; mode=recent returns chronological watch events, newest first, including repeat watches, and trakt_id limits those events to one movie or show. detail=compact (default) keeps identifiers, genres, dates, play counts, and each show's watched episode count; detail=full adds all upstream metadata. media_type=all returns separate movie and show pages, each with its own pagination. Complete history spans every page until has_more is false; a missing or failed page means incomplete coverage.

tools.name: trakt_get_show_progress
tools.title: Read a show's watched progress
tools.description: Read the connected account's watched progress for one show, including completed episodes and the next episode to watch.

id.description: Trakt ID, slug, or IMDb ID from a search result.

tools.name: trakt_get_up_next
tools.title: Read up next
tools.description: Read one page of the next episode to watch across the connected account's shows in progress.

tools.name: trakt_get_stats
tools.title: Read viewing statistics
tools.description: Read the connected account's totals for movies, shows, seasons, episodes, ratings, and network activity.

tools.name: trakt_add_history
tools.title: Mark titles as watched
tools.description: Record a watch event for up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes by Trakt ID. A show or season records all its episodes, and each call adds new plays. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true. An ambiguous result may already have recorded the plays.

watched_at.description: UTC watch time, released for the release date, or unknown. Defaults to now.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_remove_history
tools.title: Remove watch history
tools.description: Remove watch events by history event ID, or every watch of up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_get_ratings
tools.title: Read your ratings
tools.description: Read one page of the connected account's ratings for movies, shows, episodes, seasons, or everything.

rating.description: Rating filter, required for seasons and accepted only for seasons.

tools.name: trakt_add_ratings
tools.title: Rate titles
tools.description: Set a 1-10 rating on up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_remove_ratings
tools.title: Remove ratings
tools.description: Remove the connected account's rating from up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_get_collection
tools.title: Read your collection
tools.description: Read the connected account's collected movies, shows, episodes, or all media. Movies, episodes, and all media return one page; shows return the whole collection and take no page or limit.

tools.name: trakt_add_collection
tools.title: Add titles to your collection
tools.description: Add up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes to the connected account's collection by Trakt ID. Collecting a title does not mark it watched. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_remove_collection
tools.title: Remove titles from your collection
tools.description: Remove up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes from the connected account's collection by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_get_watchlist
tools.title: Read your watchlist
tools.description: Read one page of the connected account's watchlist for movies, shows, seasons, episodes, or everything, in the chosen order.

tools.name: trakt_add_watchlist
tools.title: Add titles to your watchlist
tools.description: Add up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes to the connected account's watchlist by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_remove_watchlist
tools.title: Remove titles from your watchlist
tools.description: Remove up to 100 movies, shows, seasons, or episodes from the connected account's watchlist by Trakt ID. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_discover_lists
tools.title: Discover public Trakt lists
tools.description: Browse trending or popular public Trakt lists. Optional genre filters use upstream list filtering; this is not a free-text search. Follow pagination for more results.

tools.name: trakt_get_list_items
tools.title: Read a Trakt list
tools.description: Read a page of movie, show, or all items from a public or authorized list using its owner and list ID, with optional sorting and library filters. Follow pagination for all items; reading a list does not grant edit permission.

tools.name: trakt_get_my_lists
tools.title: Read your lists
tools.description: Read one page of the personal lists owned by the connected account.

tools.name: trakt_create_list
tools.title: Create a personal Trakt list
tools.description: Create a list owned by the connected account. Lists are private unless privacy=public is explicitly requested. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true. An ambiguous result may already have created the list.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_update_list
tools.title: Edit your list
tools.description: Change the name, description, privacy, or display options of a list owned by the connected account. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_delete_list
tools.title: Delete your list
tools.description: Delete a list owned by the connected account and all its items. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_add_list_items
tools.title: Add titles to your list
tools.description: Add up to 100 distinct movie, show, season, or episode Trakt IDs to a list owned by the connected account. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true. Items already on the list are reported as existing.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_remove_list_items
tools.title: Remove titles from your list
tools.description: Remove up to 100 distinct movie, show, season, or episode Trakt IDs from a list owned by the connected account. Requires write authorization and confirmed=true. Items not on the list are reported as not found.

confirmed.description: True only when the user authorized this concrete change.

tools.name: trakt_request_login
tools.title: Connect your Trakt account
tools.description: Start a Trakt device login for the connected user and return the activation URL and user code. Browser OAuth normally creates the connection; this reconnects it.

tools.name: trakt_confirm_login
tools.title: Complete Trakt connection
tools.description: Complete a device login after the user approves the code, replacing the connection's Trakt authorization on success. Returns authorization_pending until approval and slow_down when polled faster than the returned interval. Trakt tokens stay on the server.
